notes.title: DungeonSmash has been released!
notes.content: Dungeon Smash has been released and we're pretty excited for you to play it. There is a wide variety of levels that use the game mechanics in unexpected ways, we offer a lot of levels with different peaks of difficulty and other levels to have fun with the chaos of the game. We hope you enjoy it and also stay tuned for the next update, which will add more support, new fixes and most importantly: More levels and power ups to boost gameplay.
